title: UI/UX Designer
summary: A UI/UX designer works out how a product should work and look, from user research to final screens. They sit in a product team with product managers and developers, and test designs with real users.
dailyDuties: Turn problems into wireframes and user flows
Design screens and components in Figma
Build clickable prototypes and run usability tests
Use and extend the design system
Check designs for WCAG contrast and screen reader support

skills.expectation: Design screens and components in Figma
Turn a problem into wireframes quickly
Design clear flows, states and visual hierarchy
Build clickable prototypes to test ideas
Run a usability test and act on findings
Use and extend a design system
Design for WCAG contrast and screen readers
Understand what is easy or hard to build

certifications.why: A low-cost structured course that freshers in India use to show UX fundamentals.
